name: Jupyter
description: Jupyter notebook support for Nimbalyst: custom `.ipynb` editor with real kernel execution through managed local Jupyter kernels.
author: Nimbalyst

manualServerUrl.description: Optional localhost Jupyter server URL. Leave empty to use the managed server. Authentication tokens are session-only and are never persisted.

manualServerRoot.description: Optional filesystem root of a manually started local Jupyter server. Used to start kernels in the notebook directory.

pythonPath.description: Python executable used by the managed Jupyter server. Choose it from the notebook Runtime panel.

enablement.purpose: Start and manage a local Jupyter server so notebooks can execute cells through Python kernels.

marketplace.changelog: 0.4.0: First marketplace release with a managed local Jupyter runtime, guided Python and Jupyter setup, a slim notebook editor, and AI tools for cell CRUD, execution, variable introspection, and DataFrame previews.
marketplace.longDescription: Open, edit, and execute .ipynb files in a notebook editor built with JupyterLab notebook components. Cells run against a token-secured local Jupyter server managed by the extension backend module, with an escape hatch for user-started localhost servers. Core Jupyter MIME rendering covers code, markdown, HTML, images, LaTeX, and errors; core ipywidgets controls are supported. nbformat round-trip preserves cell IDs and metadata. AI tools can read, edit, run cells, inspect outputs, and request a compact notebook projection that hides large outputs by default.
highlights: Real cell execution through managed local Jupyter kernels
Core Jupyter MIME rendering plus core ipywidgets controls
AI tools: full cell CRUD, execution with timeouts and interrupt, and compact projections
Agents can inspect kernel variables, preview DataFrames, and view plot images
Cell staleness flags tell agents which cells need re-running
nbformat round-trip preserves cell IDs and metadata
